en.cliBroken: The CLI was found but could not run
en.cliChecking: Checking this device for the Claude Code CLI…
en.cliConfiguredMissing: The CLI path set in settings does not exist: {path}
en.cliInstallCommand: Runs on this device: {command} (requires Node.js 18 or later)
en.cliInstalling: Installing… (usually a minute or two; keep DSH open)
en.cliIntro: The cc group only serves the official Claude Code client, so Claude requests on cc keys go through this device's Claude Code CLI; cc-sale, cc-expensive, claude-officially and other groups keep the built-in HTTP route. The key's groups decide the route. Either way DSH runs the tools, permissions, plan mode, attachments and history the same; the CLI only carries the request to PackyCode.
en.cliMissingHint: Keys in the cc group need it to use the Claude models (claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-haiku-5-5). Other groups and models are unaffected.
en.cliNetwork: The download failed. Check your network or npm registry settings and retry.
en.cliNotFoundAfterInstall: npm reported success, but the claude command still cannot be found. Run claude --version in a terminal, then click Check again.
en.cliNpmMissing: npm was not found. Install Node.js 18 or later from https://nodejs.org, then click Install again.
en.cliOutdated: Claude Code CLI is too old
en.cliOutdatedHint: The plugin needs {minVersion} or later. Until it is updated, Claude requests on cc keys cannot be sent; other groups and models are unaffected.
en.cliPermission: npm cannot write its global directory. Run sudo {command} in a terminal, or point npm’s global prefix at a folder you own, then retry.
en.cliPermissionWindows: npm cannot write its global directory. Open a terminal as administrator, run {command}, then click Check again.
en.cliTimeout: The install timed out. Check your network and retry.
en.cliUpdateAvailable: Version {latest} is available. The installed version keeps working until you update.
en.cliUpdateBroken: The CLI no longer runs after the update. Click Reinstall, or run {command} in a terminal.
en.cliUpdateNotInstalled: No CLI was found to update. Click Check again.
en.cliUpdateNotUpdated: The update ran, but the version is still {version} and the latest is {latest}. Run {command} in a terminal and follow what it says (for a Homebrew install, brew upgrade claude-code), then click Check again. The installed version keeps working.
en.cliUpdateStillOutdated: The update ran, but the version is still below {minVersion}. Run {command} in a terminal and follow what it says (for a Homebrew install, brew upgrade claude-code), then click Check again.
en.cliUpdateUnchanged: The update ran; the version is still {version}.
en.cliUpdating: Updating… (usually a minute or two; keep DSH open)
en.cliWindowsNote: On Windows, Claude Code also needs Git for Windows (https://git-scm.com/downloads/win).
en.composerStale: Last read at {time}; this read failed
en.diagIntro: If replies are cut off ("output token limit reached") or requests keep failing, pick the affected session, generate its diagnostics and send them to the plugin author.
en.diagPrivacy: Contains only models, reasoning effort, output limits, per-step token usage and error codes — no conversation text, file paths or keys.
en.diagSelected: All text is selected; press ⌘C or Ctrl+C to copy.
en.empty: No keys yet. Add one and the PackyCode models appear in the model picker.
en.imagesBalanceHint: Only image key balances appear here. They update every minute, or use Refresh. Conversation key balances are shown separately.
en.imagesDownloadFailed: Could not save the original. Check that the original file still exists on this device, then try Download original again.
en.imagesDraft: Use packycode_image_generate with the saved PackyCode image model and quality. Edit the attached references when provided; otherwise generate a new image. Image requirements:
en.imagesDraftBusy: The composer is busy or contains references. Describe the image requirements directly in the draft.
en.imagesIntro: Use a dedicated image key with PackyCode’s Images API. Describe a new image or attach images with editing instructions. The image engine is independent of the conversation model. Original PNGs are saved locally and previews appear in chat.
en.imagesKeyPlaceholder: Paste the dedicated image API key
en.imagesLoadFailed: Could not read image settings. If you just updated the local plugin, reload it and reopen settings.
en.imagesNoKey: No image key yet. Add one to enable the image tool. Conversation keys are never used for images.
en.imagesQualityHint: The 2.5 engines also support xhigh / max. Higher quality usually takes longer and costs more. Gateway support needs testing with an image key. Models and quality are never changed automatically.
en.imagesShortcutHint: Add a PackyCode image instruction to the draft, describe the image, then send.
en.imagesUnavailable: This host does not provide image attachments; the image tool is unavailable.
en.intro: Paste a PackyCode (PackyAPI) API key to use the built-in model route. Keys are used in order: an exhausted or rejected key hands over to the next one, and a key whose groups cannot reach the selected model is passed over for one whose groups can.
en.inviteLead: No PackyCode API key yet? You can register through this invite link:
en.keyClaudeCliHint: Group {groups} only serves the official Claude Code client, so this key's Claude requests are sent by this device's Claude Code CLI.
en.keyClaudeHttpHint: This key's Claude requests use the plugin's built-in HTTP route.
en.keysHint: Used in order: when the active key cannot serve a request, the next one takes over. “Use this key” picks the preferred key.
en.modelsEmpty: No models selected. PackyCode models are hidden from the picker.
en.modelsFailed: Could not read or save model settings
en.modelsIntro: Only selected PackyCode models appear when switching models. All are selected by default. Changes apply immediately; existing sessions can keep their current model.
en.notWritable: This profile does not allow settings writes; changes apply to this run only.
en.reviewCounts: Since this start the plugin answered {reviewed} reviews: {allowed} allowed, {denied} denied, {failed} failed.
en.reviewEnableHint: Not on yet: open DSH’s Plugins page in the sidebar, switch on “Auto authorization review”, then pick Auto review in the composer’s permission menu.
en.reviewIntro: DSH’s built-in “Auto authorization review” plugin adds Auto review to the composer’s permission menu: before each tool call a model reviews it; calls it allows run at once, calls it denies ask for your approval. It reviews with the conversation’s own model by default; this plugin can make it use the model chosen below, while what is reviewed, the rules and the outcomes stay exactly the official ones.
en.reviewLoadFailed: Could not read or save the auto review preference
en.reviewMenuNote: The description under Auto review in the permission menu comes from DSH and says the same model reviews; with jev-latest or DeepSeek Flash chosen here, that model reviews. When a review fails, DSH refuses the call instead of running it.
en.reviewModelFlashHint: About 2 s per review, and a denial says why. Needs a key whose group includes deepseek-officially.
en.reviewModelJevHint: TypeSafe’s decision classifier: about 0.4 s per review, billed by input only; a denial names only the risk level. Needs a key whose group includes typesafe-officially.
en.reviewModelSessionHint: Leave the review alone: the conversation’s own model reviews, as DSH does by default.
en.reviewUncovered: No stored key is in a group that serves {model}: reviews will fail, and DSH then refuses every tool call. Pick another reviewer, or add a key whose group includes it.
en.searchApplyFailed: Could not write the search patch: {error}
en.searchBackendDeepseekHint: {model}: a few thousand tokens per search; needs a key whose group includes DeepSeek.
en.searchBackendGptHint: {model}: usually fresher and more precise, but about 20–30K input tokens per search; needs a key whose group includes Codex.
en.searchForeign: {names} subscription plugin detected: the models it routes keep its own search choice; only the other requests reach the choice made here.
en.searchIntro: DSH’s web_search can use the DeepSeek/GPT backend selected here. Claude follows the same routing settings as other models. Each search is a separate model call billed to the plugin-stored keys.
en.searchLoadFailed: Could not read or save the search preference
en.searchModeAutoHint: PackyCode models search through PackyCode; other models keep the search they had (DSH’s default, or another plugin’s choice).
en.searchModeDefaultHint: Leave DSH search routing untouched (the default). Switching back here removes the search patch this plugin wrote into the profile.
en.searchModePackycodeHint: Every request DSH’s default search would have served goes through PackyCode. Models another subscription plugin (Codex, Kimi) routes keep that plugin’s choice.
en.searchNotWritable: This profile does not allow settings writes.
en.searchOverridden: The base search is {base}, not PackyCode: the reload may still be running, or another plugin’s patch overrides it.
en.searchPatchNote: By model and Always write a marked web entry into this profile’s cordis.patch.yml; it hot-applies, no restart needed. Switch back to Off before uninstalling the plugin.
en.searchUnavailable: This runtime has no DSH web search service; search routing has no effect.
en.staleNote: Last read at {time}; this read failed: {error}
en.versionCooling: v{version} was published recently. DSH’s pnpm installs a new version only after its release cooldown; update again later.
en.versionCoolingUntil: v{version} was published recently. DSH’s pnpm installs a new version only after its release cooldown; update after {time}.
en.versionFailed: Could not check the latest version.
en.versionLinked: Installed from a local checkout. Pull and rebuild the plugin repository instead.
en.versionManual: This install cannot be updated here. Reinstall dsh-packycode-api from the desktop Plugins page.
en.versionRestartHint: The plugin cannot safely restart the desktop application. Quit DSH completely, then open it again.
en.versionUpdatedHint: Quit and reopen the desktop application. Refreshing the page does not reload the plugin inside the Host.
en.versionUpdateFailed: The update failed. Try again, or reinstall from the Plugins page.
en.versionUpdateSyncing: v{version} was published only recently and the install source has not synced it yet. Update again in a few minutes; a regional mirror can take longer.
en.versionUpdateSyncingFrom: v{version} was published only recently and the install source {registry} has not synced it yet. Update again in a few minutes; a regional mirror can take longer.
en.versionUpdateUnreachable: Could not reach the install source to download v{version}. Check the network or proxy, then try again.
en.versionUpdateUnreachableFrom: Could not reach the install source {registry} to download v{version}. Check the network or proxy, then try again.
